figures.name: Sanghyang Widhi Wasa

ability.name: Divine Unity
ability.description: Remove all negative effects from the field; restore all allied cards to full stats.

figures.description: The supreme deity of Balinese Hinduism, the formless all-encompassing god who manifests through all other deities, unique to Bali's syncretic tradition.

figures.name: Barong

ability.name: Sacred Dance
ability.description: Nullify all dark magic cast this turn; every allied card gains a blessing shield.

figures.description: The lion-like protective spirit, king of the spirits and representation of good, who eternally battles Rangda in the great cosmic struggle.

figures.name: Rangda

ability.name: Leyak Terror
ability.description: Transform all enemy minions into leyak demons under your control; they serve you for 1 turn.

figures.description: The demon queen and widow-witch of Balinese mythology, leader of the leyaks, who battles Barong in a cosmic struggle that represents the balance of good and evil.

figures.name: Dewi Sri

ability.name: Rice Harvest
ability.description: Double all resource generation for 2 turns; all allied cards are sustained without cost.

figures.description: The rice goddess and goddess of fertility in Bali, whose myth of death and rebirth mirrors the agricultural cycle, central to Balinese village life.

figures.name: Dewa Ruci

ability.name: Inner Ocean
ability.description: Send one allied hero into Dewa Ruci's body to emerge fully enlightened with +5 to all stats.

figures.description: The tiny deity who lives within the ocean, met by Bima during his quest for holy water; the mystical teacher of inner truth and the divine spark within.

figures.name: Batara Guru (Bali)

ability.name: Cosmic Instruction
ability.description: Teach any allied card a new ability: copy one ability from any card that has been played.

figures.description: Shiva as the supreme teacher deity in Balinese cosmology, lord of the mountains and master of all knowledge.

figures.name: Kala (Bali)

ability.name: Purification Curse
ability.description: Place a Kala curse on one enemy; they lose 2 stats each turn until cleansed.

figures.description: The son of Batara Guru and Dewi Uma in Balinese myth, born from the sea foam, ruler of the earth and lord of misfortune who can also purify through ceremony.

figures.name: Dewi Uma

ability.name: Transformation Blessing
ability.description: Transform one allied card into a more powerful version of itself for 2 turns.

figures.description: The consort of Batara Guru, beautiful goddess who was cursed to become the demon Durga, cycling between divine beauty and terrifying power.

figures.name: Bima (Bali)

ability.name: Wind Son's Might
ability.description: Deal 9 damage to one enemy; if seeking wisdom, gain +2 wisdom permanently.

figures.description: The second Pandava hero of the Balinese Mahabharata tradition, son of the wind god, who underwent many spiritual quests unique to Balinese interpretation.

figures.name: Wisnu (Bali)

ability.name: Cosmic Turtle
ability.description: Become immovable for 2 turns; all attacks against you are reflected.

figures.description: Vishnu as worshipped in Bali, the preserver of the universe, whose avatar as the cosmic turtle holds up the world.

figures.name: Twalen

ability.name: Servant's Wisdom
ability.description: Reveal the opponent's hand; choose one card to be discarded from their hand.

figures.description: The divine clown-servant of Balinese wayang kulit theater, secretly a form of Maha Iswara who chose to incarnate as a humble servant, combining humor with deep spiritual wisdom.

figures.name: Mredah

ability.name: Comic Relief
ability.description: Remove one debuff from any allied card; the enemy is distracted, losing their next attack.

figures.description: The son and companion of Twalen in Balinese shadow puppet theater, part of the divine clown-servant pair whose humor carries profound spiritual meaning.

figures.name: Durga (Bali)

ability.name: Graveyard Queen
ability.description: Revive one destroyed allied card with half stats; draw power from the graveyard.

figures.description: The fearsome form of Dewi Uma after her curse, associated with graveyards and death in Balinese tradition, also protective when properly propitiated.

figures.name: Hanoman (Bali)

ability.name: Burning Lanka
ability.description: Set the entire enemy field ablaze; all enemies take 4 fire damage per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The monkey hero of the Balinese Ramayana, celebrated in the famous Kecak fire dance, whose burning tail set Lanka ablaze.

figures.name: Jero Gede Mecaling

ability.name: Plague Crossing
ability.description: Spread a plague across the enemy field; all enemies lose 2 HP per turn for 3 turns.

figures.description: The great fanged demon lord of Nusa Penida who sends disease to Bali, both feared and propitiated to ward off plague.

figures.name: Sang Hyang Semara

ability.name: Love Arrow
ability.description: Make one enemy card switch sides and fight for you for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Balinese god of love and the moon, whose beautiful music and golden arrows inspire love in gods and mortals alike.

figures.name: Dewi Ratih

ability.name: Moonlight Blessing
ability.description: All allied cards under moonlight gain +2 magic and +2 wisdom for 2 turns.

figures.description: The moon goddess and consort of Sang Hyang Semara, whose beauty causes Kala to chase the moon, creating eclipses.

figures.name: Leak (Leyak)

ability.name: Cremation Ground
ability.description: Prowl cremation grounds; steal the power of one recently destroyed card permanently.

figures.description: The shape-shifting leyak, a human practitioner of black magic who transforms into terrifying forms at night to prey on the living.

figures.name: Ratu Gede Mas Mecaling

ability.name: Fang Curse
ability.description: Curse one enemy; they cannot use healing or resurrection abilities for 3 turns.

figures.description: A terrible fanged spirit ruler of the lower realms, associated with Jero Gede Mecaling, whose large teeth symbolize demonic power.

figures.name: Sang Hyang Tunggal

ability.name: Before All Things
ability.description: Reset the entire field to its starting state; all cards return to beginning stats and positions.

figures.description: The primordial oneness before creation in Balinese cosmology, the undifferentiated source from which all deities and the universe emerged.
